|translation='''Title:''' DS-61-3.

'''Card text:''' Any starship he pilots is power +3. While aboard Black 3, maneuver is +1, and he may draw one battle destiny even if otherwise unable to draw one.

'''Lore:''' Pilot DS-61-3. He flies Black 3 as the right wingman in formation with Vader's craft. A highly skilled Corellian pilot known for ferocity in combat. Also known as “one who strikes by surprise.”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese nickname means “one who strikes by surprise”; the English calls him “Backstabber.”
